aiResearchSummary.text: DataStax is researching and developing methods for data streaming between nodes of a database system, as described in 'Data streaming between nodes of a database system,' which details how nodes in a cluster transfer data segments efficiently. Additionally, 'Trie-based indices for databases' outlines the use of byte ordering for keys and trie indices to reference stored data, enhancing database indexing. These areas reflect a focus on distributed database performance and indexing techniques.
